fields: rankRetentionEdgeState = RETAINED / EXITED / ENTERED / NON_WINNER / GAP_UNKNOWN / UNKNOWN

adjacency.rule: Retention duration may advance only if current and previous observations are consecutive official market sessions AND both clean full-universe rank receipts are complete.

controls: market regime and validated R06 transition state
market realized volatility when prospectively available
primaryIncrementalQuestion: Conditional on current ret60 rank level, does RETAINED winner membership / rank stability add information beyond existing own-path trend consistency and Residual RS?
falsification: If retention adds no value after current rank level/ret60, reject duration as redundant.
If effect is fully absorbed by residualSectorRs20 or existing persistenceScoreResearch, reject as redundant.
If only a few dates/sectors drive the result, classify fragile.
If missing clean scan dates are treated as exits, invalidate the study.
If full-universe membership changes materially drive rank changes, require universe-composition controls before interpretation.
If effect exists only after importing paper monthly thresholds/effect sizes into daily data, reject transportability.

governance.runtimeCaptureIfLater: Class A only if computed from already-loaded featureRows, stored only in Shadow/research context, zero external calls, decisionImpact=false, Formal invariants unchanged.
